instances.label: staining
instances.loc: exterior plastered wall, lower area below and between the two ventilation openings

description.morph: broad irregular dark gray to black area staining with dense mottling, diffuse edges, and several downward streaks
description.extent_module: covers most of the lower two-thirds of the visible wall and extends beneath both openings
description.context: pale yellow-gray discoloration is visible above the darkest band; local surface loss and cracking occur within the stained area

instances.label: material loss
instances.loc: exterior plastered wall, lower central area below the gap between the two ventilation openings

description.morph: one irregular patch of surface loss exposing a lighter coarse substrate, with jagged edges and smaller adjacent losses
description.extent_module: approximately one-quarter of the width of the right ventilation opening
description.context: the loss lies inside the darkest stained band and is crossed at its lower edge by a horizontal crack

instances.label: cracking
instances.loc: exterior plastered wall, vertical strip below the gap between the two ventilation openings

description.morph: irregular near-vertical crack with local branching, accompanied by a short horizontal crack across the lower central patch
description.extent_module: extends from just below opening-sill level through approximately one opening height of wall surface
description.context: the crack crosses dark staining and meets the edge of the local surface-loss area

instances.label: cracking
instances.loc: exterior plastered wall, upper area above the right ventilation opening near the eave

description.morph: narrow irregular vertical crack descending from the eave zone toward the right opening head, with a visibly wider dark segment near its lower end
description.extent_module: approximately half the height of the right ventilation opening
description.context: the crack passes through pale discolored plaster; no clear surface loss is visible along most of its length
